worldattribute-complexnutritionStart-des: How much is in a new character's calorie reserve when they first spawn. Their vitamin and mineral stores start at the same share: full on Full, 70% on Easy, half on Normal, and so on. It only applies the first time a character joins the world; Respawn calories sets what you come back with after dying.
worldconfig-complexnutritionStart-RockBo: Rock Bottom: 0.01 days calorie reserve (good luck!)
worldattribute-complexnutritionRespawn-d: How much is in a character's calorie reserve when they respawn after dying. Their vitamin and mineral stores are set to the same share, and their gut, fiber and the last 24 hours of digestion are cleared.
worldconfig-complexnutritionRespawn-Rock: Rock Bottom: 0.01 days calorie reserve (good luck!)
worldattribute-complexnutritionAdvancedD: Shows more detail when you hover over the Carbs, Fats and Protein bars: how many calories the food being digested will give, how long it will take and how fast it is being absorbed. Each player can change this for themselves in game by typing /cnutrition display.
worldattribute-complexnutritionMeatInPot: All poultry and bushmeat in pots
Lets raw, cooked and cured poultry and bushmeat go into meat stews and soups as regular ingredients. Changing it takes effect the next time the world is loaded.
worldattribute-complexnutritionDiscover-: Hides a food's nutrients (shown as ???) until you have eaten it. Eating a meal or pie teaches you each of its ingredients. How filling a food is still shows. The nutrition window only suggests foods you have eaten.
worldattribute-complexnutritionDiminishi: When on, eating a lot of one thing gives less and less: carbs, fats and protein give fewer calories past a day's worth, and vitamins and minerals count for less past a day's worth in one sitting. Switch it off and every gram counts in full.
worldattribute-complexnutritionWildHarve: How much a wild crop gives when you harvest it, compared with the same crop grown on farmland. A wild spelt plant gives about 1 or 2 grain at 25% (vanilla), 2 to 4 at 50%, and as much as a farmed one (5 to 7) at 100%. Seeds are not affected.
worldattribute-complexnutritionMaxFullne: How much your stomach holds, in fullness. 300 is about 1 kilogram of food. Fullness always empties at 100 an hour and only decides how much you can eat at once. 0 means no limit.
